research_question: Can every LNv, LNd and DN1 sample column in the GSE77451 processed ESAT matrices be mapped one-to-one to an official GEO sample, cell-group label and ZT timepoint, while preserving the two independent time-course groupings?
hypothesis: The 36 columns in the three processed matrices map to 36 unique GSM records and form two complete six-timepoint collections per cell group.
alternative_hypotheses: Some matrix columns may not have a unique official GEO sample/title match.
GEO type/source or ZT metadata may disagree with a matrix label or curator-provided mapping.
Time-course grouping inferred from GEO title blocks may not recover the study's intended independent series; if so, grouping must remain unresolved rather than silently inferred.
preparation: Public processed ESAT transcript-level RNA-seq matrices and NCBI GEO family SOFT sample metadata; no new wet-lab measurements.
cell_type: Source GEO groups LNv, LNd and DN1; LNv is a mixed PDF-positive s-/l-LNv pool, LNd includes the fifth PDF-negative s-LNv, and DN1 is a subset.
experimental_unit: pooled_neuron_library; the GEO sample/library accession is the record key, not an identified individual fly
primary_readout: One-to-one mapping count and consistency of matrix column, GSM accession, GEO title alias, source/type and ZT/CT timepoint.
secondary_readouts: Completeness of each curator-labelled six-timepoint collection at four-hour intervals.
Presence of the full 48-sample series family SOFT while mapping only the three clock-neuron matrices (36 samples).
Preservation of unknown sex, age, genotype and temperature fields in the output metadata.
time_system: ZT from official GEO sample characteristics: LNv/LNd ZT2, ZT6, ZT10, ZT14, ZT18, ZT22; DN1 ZT3, ZT7, ZT11, ZT15, ZT19, ZT23.
required_metadata: Processed matrix sample-column names and matrix path.
Explicit matrix-column alias, GSM accession and curator-assigned timecourse ID.
Official GEO family SOFT sample title, source name, type and timepoint characteristics.
Primary-paper sampling design: two independent six-timepoint collections, LD, approximately 50-100 isolated neurons per sample.
analysis_plan: Parse sample records from the official NCBI GEO family SOFT file. Compare every explicit mapping row against matrix headers, normalize only punctuation/case for the declared matrix alias-to-GEO-title check, require exact GSM uniqueness and GEO source/type agreement, parse the official ZT/CT characteristic, and verify two curator-labelled six-point courses with the same complete four-hour time grid per matrix. Export a metadata CSV but do not read or analyze expression values. Run synthetic positive/negative tests, full unit suite, manifest validation and isolated replay.
decision_gate: Verify only if all 36 processed-matrix columns map exactly once to unique GSM records; aliases match official GEO titles; all source/type labels and timepoints parse and agree; each of the two course groupings per matrix has six unique points at four-hour intervals with matching grids; synthetic swapped-GSM, missing-column and duplicate-timepoint cases are rejected; and isolated replay reproduces both output hashes.
acceptance_tests: Synthetic valid mapping passes and emits metadata without promoting pooled libraries to individual flies.
Swapped GSM accessions are blocked by matrix alias versus official GEO title mismatch.
Any matrix column absent from the mapping CSV blocks the audit.
Duplicate timepoints within a six-point course block the audit.
All 36 real matrix columns match 36 unique GSM records from the official 48-sample family SOFT.
Each real LNv/LNd course maps ZT2-22 and each DN1 course maps ZT3-23 in four-hour steps.
The manifest validates and isolated replay verifies the audit JSON and metadata CSV hashes.

verification.real_data_execution: verified_geo_sample_mapping; 36 of 36 matrix columns mapped to unique GSM records
verification.family_soft_records: 48 parsed; 36 used for the LNv/LNd/DN1 matrices
verification.isolated_replay: verified_public_dataset_replay; 1 run; 2 output hashes; zero issues

limitations: Course IDs are curator-assigned from the two-time-course design and GEO sample-title blocks; they are not native GEO characteristics.
The output experimental unit is a pooled neuron library; underlying fly identities/replication are not recoverable from these records.
Sex, age, genotype and temperature remain not reported in the sample records used by this mapping task.
This task establishes metadata alignment only; it does not resolve the ESAT expression scale, normalize expression, aggregate transcript isoforms, test rhythmicity, or establish ion-channel function.
The LNv group mixes s-LNv and l-LNv, LNd includes the fifth PDF-negative s-LNv, and DN1 represents a subset rather than all user-requested DN subtypes.
